description: Power Outage data for US is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Kunal Mahajan. The aim of the project is to detect power outages in real-time in United States by utilizing IP scans done periodically. For each scan, the active IP addresses are stored. Based on the time series data for each IP, a reliability score is computed for each IP. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
